title: VipPerkCreateRequest
description: vip.perk-create-request@1: the body of vip.perk.create on OpenVibe.VIP. POST /api/v1/perks: { creator?, key?, name, description?, kind?, bindings? } defines a perk for a creator (a service names the creator; a person defines their own; staff may name network). key defaults to the name, and must read as a slug (1-48 of a-z, 0-9 and -, lowercased); kind defaults to other. Refusals are problem+json: 422 vip.invalid_input (no name, a bad key, kind or binding) or vip.text_too_long; 409 vip.perk_exists (the key is taken); 403 capability.denied or vip.not_yours. Unknown fields are ignored.

creator.description: The creator the perk belongs to (a user SubjectRef, or network for staff).

anyOf.description: A usr_ id, a VIP username, or network.

bindings.description: Replaces the perk's active bindings (a binding left out is removed). Each (product, binding) at most once.

product.description: A service id: live, chat, community, blog, …
